summary: Kyivstar Group Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Q2 2026 earnings release and investor presentation. The filing reports financial and operating results: total revenue of USD 339 million (+19.3% YoY), EBITDA of USD 188 million (+13.7% YoY), net profit of USD 77 million (-5.7% YoY), and raised 2026 revenue and EBITDA outlook. It notes a USD 21.2 million non-cash warrant loss in the quarter. This is a routine earnings disclosure for a foreign private issuer, containing no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, strategic review, or management change. The registrant is a telecommunications operator reporting quarterly results, with no transactional or structural corporate event.
